name: WAR DUST VR : STORM | 32vs32 Battlefields
detailed_description:
STORM is the cross-platform version of War Dust, letting you play the epic large scale battlefield shooter with a bigger playerbase across PC and mobile platforms.

STORM is a 32v32 VR military shooter where infantry and vehicles fight on huge battlefields. With its emphasis on fun, balanced mechanics, and fast-paced action, War Dust Storm delivers an immersive battlefield experience that will keep you coming back for more.

Immersive Tactical Warfare

Experience conquest-style gameplay where capturing control points and defeating enemies is key. Progress through an XP system to unlock a vast arsenal of weapons, accessories, skins, and ammunition types. Choose from four distinct classes – Assault, Engineer, Support, and Scout – and strategize to dominate the battlefield.

Features:

  • 4 types of vehicles

  • 15 types of guns

  • Multiple explosives

  • Multiple support, buildables, cover and medical tools

    What Sets War Dust Storm Apart?

    The size and scope of the huge 32v32 battles is unique. Movement options like paragliding, flying, and driving vehicles, along with squad-based spawning, allow players to manoeuvrer quickly across these large areas to hunt enemies and capture control points ensuring a unique genre of high intensity fast-action combat.

    All that sharing the experience with players from all the VR player-base through highly optimized cross-platform servers.

    Locomotion Options

    War Dust Storm features multiple locomotion options to suit different playstyles and accessibility needs:

    • Classic joystick locomotion: Standard VR shooter movement.

    • FitRun: Run-in-place locomotion for players who enjoy physical activity while gaming.

    • PRO Locomotion: High-agility, air-grab locomotion featured in most Raptor Lab games.

    Players can play seated or standing, with the ability to crouch, prone, and rotate using thumbsticks for added flexibility. Locomotion options include:

    Locomotion can be controller- or headset-directed, with options for smooth or snap turning. These features ensure a tailored and comfortable experience for all players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4th gen or equivalent
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR
  • Additional Notes: Disc space required may increase with content updates.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7th or equivalent
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2070 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Disc space required may increase with content updates.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features scenes of war and violent combats between military forces.
